source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 12 ("County of Antrim Notice of Result of Elections 1967")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 24 divisions, 25 seats (Newtownabbey two): 5 contested (Ballycastle, Ballygomartin, Ballymena, Finaghy, Glenarm) and 19 unopposed, all named in the returning officer's notice of result. The notice prints no party labels; those shown for the contested divisions come from the Belfast Telegraph round-up of 2 June.

note: Election of the Antrim County Council, polled 1 June 1967 (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, 'Round Up of the County Councils'). The returning officer's 'County of Antrim Notice of Result of Elections 1967' (Belfast Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 12), signed by W. S. Henderson, prints all 24 county electoral divisions: surname, other names, place of residence, votes recorded and names elected. It is the source for the unopposed returns, whose vote column is blank. No poll; vote column blank. McConnell is entered in column 7 of the notice, 'Names of Retired Members Deemed to be Re-elected'. Returned unopposed.
